action.command: echo "=== can we reach a public ghcr image (nginx)? ==="; timeout 60 docker pull ghcr.io/linuxserver/swag:latest 2>&1 | tail -3 || echo "pull failed"; echo "=== try ghcr anonymous token for the project image ==="; TOKEN=$(curl -s "https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository:smart-village-solutions/sva-studio:pull" | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{try{console.log(JSON.parse(d).token||'')}catch{console.log('no-token')}})"); echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'manifest HEAD status: %{http_code}\n' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json, application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json, application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json" https://ghcr.io/v2/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio/manifests/latest

tool_call.name: terminal
